      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Modifications to policy code are mechanical cleanups directly subordinate to the consensus rule additions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",

    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",

    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+1/-0) to report the BIP 54 deployment.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "The single-line RPC change is purely incidental reporting of the new consensus deployment."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds extensive unit, fuzz, and functional tests (bip54_tests.cpp, feature_bip54.py, bip54.cpp) that specifically exercise BIP 54 consensus logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests that pin the behavior of consensus rules belong to the validation category rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 soft fork consensus validation rules in src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and consensus headers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "The PR implements consensus rules resolving long-standing consensus hazards including legacy sigops computational DoS, timewarp attacks, and Merkle tree collisions. While restricted to regtest to unblock multi-node testing without immediate mainnet activation, proposed soft fork rules represent strategically critical consensus work that warrants deep, deliberate review."
    },

      "rationale": "No wallet interfaces, databases, or key-handling logic are altered."
    }
